source_snapshot.procedure: Run errormode1/mcapolling0/errortype1 once at unexplained address0xd00 after ambiguous profiles.
source_snapshot.criteria: UCE report and shutdown/restart without exact deadlines.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generic logs cannot validate address or recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires address-space meaning, per-slot map, UCE disposition and poison cleanup.

old_problem: 0xd00 is below the normal first-page boundary and has no stated meaning as system address, UMC-relative offset or placeholder, so the destructive command cannot establish any slot target or safe ownership.
disposition_reason: Unlike a missing runtime address, the tool's interpretation of its `address` argument is unknown and changes the operation itself. Substituting a pinned page is unsafe until AMD documentation proves whether errormode1 consumes a system physical address or relative offset. ED-16 also requires deterministic restart and poison recovery before one UCE. These core command/recovery semantics cannot be supplied by generic standards, so Pending/BLOCKED is retained.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row 46, same-row AI fields, historical record 2448 and next pending row 47.
Preserved explicit-address errortype1, slot1~N and shutdown/restart coverage.
Did not reinterpret or replace 0xd00 without a versioned tool contract.
Kept each slot as a separately authorized destructive checkpoint with OOB capture.
No memory address, injection, shutdown or recovery action occurred.

test_case.test_name: AMD explicit-address uncorrectable DRAM event per slot
test_case.purpose: Exercise an approved explicit-address UCE for each populated slot and verify exact attribution, bounded shutdown/restart, poison cleanup and recovered memory integrity.
required_package: AMD definition of errormode1 address space and validity of 0xd00
Per-slot topology, decoder and safe pinned/selected target
UCE event plus shutdown/restart deadlines and OS/BMC oracle
OOB boot recovery, persistent-poison cleanup and restoration
test_case.test_command: Do not execute or substitute the address. After the AMD owner defines the address field, map one safe target to one slot, authorize one UCE under continuous OOB observation, correlate exact address/location/syndrome and platform records, complete the approved restart/poison cleanup, restore state and separately authorize another slot.
test_case.expected_result: Each independently approved slot produces the intended UCE at the proven address, performs the specified bounded shutdown/restart response, boots healthy with no residual poison and returns all RAS state to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS exists until address-space semantics and recovery are authoritative. Tool PASS at 0xd00, generic UCE text, an uncontrolled reboot, boot loop or uncleaned poison cannot pass.
safety_gate: Backed-up dedicated ECC SUT with independent OOB power/reimage path.
No command until address interpretation, ownership, target slot and recovery are signed.
One UCE/slot only; abort on wrong slot, unexpected severity, lost console or failed boot.
Never auto-retry or continue after restart.
expected_evidence: Versioned address-space contract and slot target proof
Continuous OOB, OS and management UCE timeline
Poison cleanup, restoration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The required recovery is itself unresolved: the owner must define restart, persistent-poison removal, possible power/reimage actions and health gates before destructive execution can be authorized.

source_conflict.reason: The address operand, slot mapping, profile relationship and recovery remain execution-defining unknowns.

blocked.reason: A destructive UCE cannot use an address whose namespace and ownership are unknown, and no safe recovery is yet authoritative.
